components.purpose: Full-width opening banner at the top of the page, with Heading/Description and two button fields (cta1, cta2) for the two required CTAs.
Customer logos section — a nested grid of LogoItem entries to showcase client/partner logos.
Features grid with screenshots — configurable 2/3/4 column grid of FeatureItem entries, each with its own image attachment to show a screenshot/graphic per feature.
Three key stats — heading/description above a row of stat tiles (value + label) via the nested Stats grid.
One customer quote — links to a single TestimonialItem to display one customer testimonial.
Final contact form — heading/description plus configured contact form fields and submit handling.
